name: Metropolis Light Transport
definition: A global illumination rendering method based on Monte Carlo methods that uses Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to sample light paths x̄_i according to a target distribution π(x̄) proportional to the image contribution of the paths.
summary: Metropolis Light Transport is a global illumination method using Markov Chain Monte Carlo to explore light paths via mutations, finding complex bounces standard path tracing misses.
